content.title: Technological innovation for an effective energy transition in Colombia: a systematic review and scientometric analysis
content.objective: To map and synthesize the peer-reviewed evidence (2015-2025) on how technological advances and innovation contribute to, or are constrained in, Colombia's energy transition, combining a scientometric analysis of the field with a comparative thematic synthesis of technologies, outcomes, barriers and enablers.
content.manuscript_title: Technological innovation for the energy transition in Colombia, 2015–2025: a systematic review and scientometric analysis
content.manuscript_title_note: Operator decision (2026-11-19): protocol title shortened by dropping the evaluative word "effective" and adding the review period 2015-2025 (date_range).
